cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Close It Properly
cards.instruction: Keep them present until both of you complete the ritual that formally ends this role, meeting, or relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you leave book club, we do the closing response. I taught it to you on your first night; don't make me finish alone again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I said goodnight. My taxi's coming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good projection, wrong words. I'll say 'chapter closed'; you answer 'until next time.' Then we're finished.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's here. I'll say my bit from the car.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the window down and the driver here for one answer. I'll come beside you. Chapter closed?
